name: Devin Action
description: Triggers a Devin.ai session with a given prompt or playbook. Optimized for use directly or as a response to slash commands.

comment-id.description: Comment ID (optional, for reply chaining and context)

playbook-macro.description: Playbook macro (optional, for structured workflows) - should start with '!' (e.g., !my_playbook)

github-token.description: GitHub Token (required for posting comments and accessing repo context)

start-message.description: Message to include in the start comment

tags.description: Additional tags to apply to the Devin session (supports CSV or line-delimited format). Automatic tags are always added: gh-actions-trigger and playbook-{macro-n

dry-run.description: If 'true', the action will simulate the process without making an actual API call to Devin
